status.heading: Land builds from source today. There is no installer to download yet.
status.standfirst: macOS, Windows and Linux all build from the repository. None of them has a published installer, a signature or a checksum, so building from source is the only way to run Land right now.
status.footnote: Source build: the two-step build in the Land repository's Documentation/GitHub/Building.md. Installer, signing and checksum status is quoted from this page's release manifest.
status.sentence: Nothing here is downloadable yet. Land builds from source on macOS, Windows and Linux; public installers, signing and verification artifacts are still in preparation.

manifest.headline: RELEASE_01 lists three platforms and publishes no artifact.
manifest.footnote: The manifest carries a release index, a channel and a per-platform status. It carries no version, no release date and no artifact size - those fields print UNAVAILABLE until a public installer publishes them.

transparency.title: Telemetry Is Compile-Gated in Land.
transparency.subtitle: Telemetry and tracing are behind named Rust feature gates in the native layer. Nothing is emitted by default. Each build profile explicitly lists which paths are compiled in.
